title: Flight Simulator 2020 - Sightseeing - Fly by Nürburgring Ring
description:
In this video we will fly over the the F1 Circuit Nürburgring Ring while we are on our way to Bahrain for some F1 winter testing.

If you also want to have some nice explanations about POI's which you are passing during your flight go the to site of Bushtalk radio and download their client:

https://bushtalkradio.com/
